notes: The one universe, growing to every name anyone classifies. A declaration, nothing else: the ticker, the class a human declared for it (never inferred), why that class in words meant to hold for years, and what no model can see for the name. No outcome, number, date, tag or parameter lives here; the run records those per record, and whether anything changed since the last run is the baseline diff. The loader is strict: an unknown field is a load error. An entry may declare the SEC filer to read by cik when the ticker map points elsewhere, with the reason in why.
